subject: Recorder container format (GCAR/GCF1 + CRC32C)
rationale: Format is sound; an independent Python reimplementation reproduced the producer's own category counts exactly with 0 CRC failures

subject: Segment/manifest integrity model
rationale: 489/489 sidecars verify; 0 writer-sequence discontinuities across 290 segments

subject: Recorder provenance model
rationale: mode+provenance provider+provenance instrument contractEpoch per-segment hash already recorded - meets Task D provenance requirements

subject: Segment reader for the analysis path
rationale: 13 GB of captured market data has no consumer in the KDK analysis path; this is the largest gap found

subject: Manifest-vs-payload validator
rationale: Two curated sessions declare Dom and contain zero Depth records; nothing detects declared-but-absent streams

subject: DOM UpdateAction semantics
rationale: All 35025 decoded Depth records carry UpdateAction="Unknown" so New/Change/Delete is unrecoverable; the adapter must map the platform action or record why it cannot

subject: disabledStreams manifest field
rationale: Hard-coded to always emit Mbo with a constant string; it reads as runtime state and is not. Either populate it from actual configuration or rename it to a standing-advisory field

subject: MboOperationalBlockReason text
rationale: The constant now literally begins "WITHDRAWN 2026-07-27" yet is still emitted as a block reason on every manifest; keep the historical record but stop presenting a withdrawn reason as current

subject: MBO lifecycle reconciliation
source_location: none - lifecycleIntegrityRecordCount is 0 on every segment
rationale: MBO events are present in quantity but nothing reconciles New/Change/Delete transitions or snapshot completeness

subject: Native sequence measurement
rationale: Field exists but its distribution has never been measured; ODR-L1-03 forbids inferring provider completeness without it

subject: episode-dataset.jsonl fixture separation
rationale: 5127 fixture rows vs 15 production rows and 1 malformed line in a publicly published corpus; production observations must be separable from test data by construction

subject: episode-dataset.jsonl integrity sidecar
rationale: The one dataset KDK actually consumes has no sidecar while 489 recorder artifacts do

subject: instrument_master_gcae.json
rationale: 57242 option definitions with no producer no sidecar and no consumer; must not be adopted as an input until its origin is established

subject: Rithmic ticker-plant client
rationale: Proven against real data on three products; OI bit resolved from the generated proto enum rather than guessed

subject: OI subscription bit resolution
rationale: Reads RequestMarketDataUpdate.UpdateBits.OPEN_INTEREST and returns None when absent - correct pattern

subject: Option bid/ask persistence
rationale: Bid and ask are captured on the wire but never persisted so no crossed/one-sided/spread gate is evaluable

subject: Black-76 greeks
rationale: Offline unit-tested with the cost-of-carry assumption stated in source

subject: GEX/DEX exposure outputs
rationale: Exposure requires open interest; 0/300 contracts carried OI in the surviving artifact

subject: Direct-Rithmic reconnect/dedup/ordering
rationale: Not analysed in this pass; recorded as remaining work rather than assumed

subject: Two-branch separation
rationale: Different plants different identities different integrity models; the directive requires them kept apart

subject: Shared integrity primitives
rationale: Sharing is sensible but premature before the segment reader exists

subject: .gcae runtime data root
rationale: A data root is not a code dependency; the directive forbids a runtime dependency on legacy CODE and there is none
